description: This file defines the 'Point' class within the MigraDoc.DocumentObjectModel.Shapes.Charts namespace. The class represents a data point in a chart, including properties for visual formatting (LineFormat, FillFormat), a value, cloning capabilities, and serialization methods. It also contains internal classes for managing property values.

classes.name: Point
classes.description: Represents a formatted value used in data series within a chart, with properties for visual styles, value, cloning, and serialization.

classes.name: Point.PointValues
classes.description: Contains internal nullable properties for the Point class, including LineFormat, FillFormat, and Value.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the Point instance.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Implements deep copying logic, including cloning formats if they are not null.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Converts the Point object into a DDL representation using the provided serializer.
